text: Figure 6.123: E2E Profile 44 Header The bit numbering shown above represents the order in which bits are transmitted. The E2E header fields (e.g. E2E Counter) are encoded as: 1. Big Endian (most significant byte first) - imposed by profile 2. LSB First (least significant bit within byte first) - imposed by TCP/IP bus The header can be placed at a specific location in the protected data, by configuring the offset of the entire E2E header.
